title: Revalidate supplier comparison masters at all sourcing and conversion commitments
description: Complete procurement sourcing master integrity by removing PurchaseQuoteController.RequiresLiveMasterValidation path gate. Helper lines 89-99 bypasses PurchaseQuoteMasterReferenceRules for empty-path authorized calls; decision/single/batch conversions at lines 396/443/549 likewise gate live references. Always enforce existing product/supplier/customer live-reference rules before draft writes and approval/selection/procurement commitment, including inside current comparison locks. Retain supported nullable draft comparisons and explicit-source grouping, but no invalid supplier/product may become a committed purchase order. Reuse existing sourcing/procurement authority from ERP-486; do not grant master-maintenance permissions. Adapt existing fixtures with genuine enabled identities, existing menu grants and live master rows, never a request-path/environment/test bypass. Preserve nullable manual drafts where the established business rules allow them. Full original failure logs and explicit TRX/results directories must remain under .ai/logs/<task>; do not stage generated outputs. No schema changes or new permissions. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Draft writes and sourcing approval/selection/single/batch procurement conversion enforce existing live product/supplier/customer rules regardless of request shape. Preserve supported nullable comparison drafts, reject zero/missing/deleted/disabled explicit references and invalid procurement commitment without silent substitution.

Master invalidation during sourcing is revalidated under current locks with bounded batched reads. One invalid batch source rejects all groups before any purchase number or persistence; preserve approved price/currency/quantity, current caller/customer/menu scope, selection history and transaction integrity.

Meaningful controller and genuine isolated SQL tests cover permitted sourced commitment, nullable draft semantics, master revocation, identical populated/empty/no-context calls and zero rejected writes/numbering. Keep original conversion/master/authority regression fixtures valid, pass safe Release/full units and retain original logs.
implementation_evidence: PurchaseQuoteController.cs:89-99,396,443,549 gates live master checks on Request.Path.HasValue even after ERP-486 makes authority unconditional. ERP-476 protects HTTP references and ERP-486 identity/menu ownership; neither eliminates master-only waiver. Source/backlog/full task history inspected.
